data.body: Window position cannot be restored on Wayland: the user's session is Wayland (loginctl Type=wayland; WAYLAND_DISPLAY set) and EVERY persisted layout record held x:0 y:0, because gtk_window_get_position / tao outer_position report the origin there, xdg-shell has no position request and gtk_window_move is a no-op. Fixed in 0040fa2: a Wayland session stores no x/y and is never asked to move the window (X11 and XWayland via GDK_BACKEND=x11 keep working); size restore is unaffected. If a user reports "position not restored on Linux", check the session type and the persisted layout first — an X11 session recording x:0 y:0 means something else is wrong.
